_comment: Guild dungeon floor conditions - DESIGN-GUILD-FLOOR-CONDITIONS. One is drawn per floor per cycle from the guild's (id, cycle) seed (GuildDungeonGenerator.ConditionsFor). 'text' is the one sentence on the floor card; the harness checks every number in it against the rules. 'floors' is which floor themes may draw the condition: exactly the themes on which DevHarness --guild-conditions measured the condition passing C5 (it reorders the rosters by at least 1.5x what a pure difficulty knob or chance alone does) with all three C6 guardrails held, and build-check re-asserts it. The candidates the study cut are recorded in DESIGN-GUILD-FLOOR-CONDITIONS, not kept here. 'fight' holds BattleRules fields; 'effects' are ordinary EffectDefs each picked body applies to itself (side Enemies/Heroes/Both, pick All/Front/Toughest, everyRound false = once at the opening); 'line' holds caps and bans checked before a line is committed. Nothing here may name an enemy template or a hero: conditions are written against floor themes and engine primitives only. This file is hashed into the content version, so editing it retires every recorded replay.

floorConditions.name: Dead Air
floorConditions.text: Heroes refill only 25% of the Energy they gain from attacking and being hit.

floorConditions.name: Primed to Burst
floorConditions.text: Every hero and every enemy opens with its Active ready.

floorConditions.name: One of Each
floorConditions.text: No two heroes in the line may share a role.
